impact_scale.label: Negligible
impact_scale.description: No safety, privacy, or financial effect; purely cosmetic or informational

impact_scale.label: Minor
impact_scale.description: Minor user inconvenience; no safety impact; negligible financial loss

impact_scale.label: Moderate
impact_scale.description: Moderate financial or privacy impact; limited operational disruption; no direct safety hazard

impact_scale.label: Major
impact_scale.description: Significant safety risk, large-scale data breach, or substantial financial loss; regulatory consequences likely

impact_scale.label: Critical
impact_scale.description: Life-threatening safety impact, catastrophic data breach, or irreversible vehicle damage

attack_feasibility_scale.label: Very Low
attack_feasibility_scale.description: Requires nation-state resources, physical disassembly, and extended time (months)

attack_feasibility_scale.label: Low
attack_feasibility_scale.description: Requires specialized equipment, expert knowledge, and significant preparation

attack_feasibility_scale.label: Moderate
attack_feasibility_scale.description: Achievable with moderate skill and publicly documented techniques; requires some equipment

attack_feasibility_scale.label: High
attack_feasibility_scale.description: Achievable with publicly available tools, basic security knowledge, and short preparation

attack_feasibility_scale.label: Very High
attack_feasibility_scale.description: Trivially exploitable with no special tools or skills; attack can be automated

disclaimer: This is a prototype scoring model for educational purposes. It is NOT an organization-approved ISO/SAE 21434 risk assessment methodology.
